name: Crab
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
sourceDistinctions: The printed Crab Traits line lists Small size, blindsight 60 ft., and no Amphibious trait. Its design commentary lists different values. Clatterclaw uses the trait block.
The Monk exception on p. 7 applies to the bonus-action strike. Base Claw remains slashing on the Attack action.
Giant Crab is a separate playable profile.

name: Crocodile
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: v2 p. 227, with p. 235 cross-reference, Crocodile Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
sourceDistinctions: Giant Crocodile on p. 235 explicitly refers players to the Crocodile traits on p. 227.

The printed Bite allows a bonus-action grapple attempt after a successful Attack-action unarmed strike. Mirejaw uses its jaws and the 2014 contest. A successful bite alone does not impose grapple or restraint.
Crocodile Traits gives swim speed but omits the Hold Breath and No Hands lines mentioned in design commentary. Mirejaw has no equipment and uses the core breath rules.

name: Deer
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
sourceDistinctions: The character can supply form-appropriate somatic components under p. 8. Its spell list avoids material components, so it never needs a focus.
The 1d4 Gore has no species-granted finesse trait. Elk has its own rules.

name: Eagle
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
sourceDistinctions: The printed Talons line grants finesse for effects that require it. Brackenpin applies 2014 Sneak Attack to a qualifying Talons hit.
Giant Eagle is a separate playable profile.

name: Elephant
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: v2 p. 230, with p. 252 cross-reference, Elephant Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player rules for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printing.
sourceDistinctions: Mammoth on p. 252 explicitly refers players to Elephant traits on p. 230.
Trampling Charge grants a bonus-action attempt to knock prone after its stated movement and strike. Kettlebrow uses the 2014 shove contest and size limit.
